display_name: Awareness E8: After the click (defend only)
description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for all staff, on the defending side only. Sit in a colleague's seat at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company, after they clicked a convincing email: some of what turns up in their account is a real sign that something is wrong, and some is ordinary. Each answer is explained, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
